title: ATS Resume Prompt – Software Engineer (India)
description: Generate a modern ATS software engineer resume optimized for the Indian tech job market.
prompt:
You are an expert ATS resume writer specializing in the Indian tech job market.

TASK:
Create a complete ATS-friendly resume for a Software Engineer in India.

INPUT:
- Candidate name: [NAME]
- Location: [CITY, INDIA]
- Email: [EMAIL]
- Phone: [PHONE]
- LinkedIn: [LINK]
- GitHub: [GITHUB]
- Years of experience: [YEARS]
- Tech stack: [TECH STACK]
- Work history: [WORK EXPERIENCE]
- Education: [EDUCATION]
- Projects: [PROJECTS]
- Certifications: [CERTIFICATIONS]

RULES:
- Use clean ATS format (no tables, no icons)
- Use strong action verbs
- Add measurable achievements
- Include a Skills section optimized for Indian recruiters
- Keep it professional and modern

OUTPUT:
Return the full resume in plain text format with clear headings.

title: Bug Fixing Assistant Prompt
description: Debug code faster with structured error analysis and step-by-step reasoning.
prompt:
You are a senior software engineer and debugging expert.

TASK:
Analyze the following code and fix the bug.

INPUT:
- Programming language: [LANGUAGE]
- Code:
[PASTE CODE HERE]
- Error message:
[PASTE ERROR HERE]

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Explain what the bug is.
2. Explain why it happens.
3. Provide the corrected code.
4. Suggest improvements to prevent similar bugs.
5. If multiple fixes exist, show the safest fix.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
- Bug Explanation
- Root Cause
- Fixed Code
- Improvements

title: Startup Pitch Deck Prompt (India)
description: Generate an investor-ready pitch deck outline for Indian startup funding.
prompt:
You are a startup pitch deck expert specializing in Indian investors and funding rounds.

TASK:
Create an investor-ready pitch deck outline for an Indian startup.

INPUT:
- Startup name: [STARTUP NAME]
- Industry: [INDUSTRY]
- Target market: [TARGET MARKET]
- Product description: [PRODUCT]
- Business model: [BUSINESS MODEL]
- Competitors: [COMPETITORS]
- Traction: [TRACTION]
- Revenue (if any): [REVENUE]
- Funding ask: [FUNDING AMOUNT]
- Use of funds: [USE OF FUNDS]

REQUIREMENTS:
- Include Indian market context (TAM/SAM/SOM in India)
- Include investor-friendly structure
- Include key metrics investors in India care about

OUTPUT:
Write a slide-by-slide pitch deck structure with bullet points and suggested slide titles.
